sentences.text: Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) confirmed he was present for the review on Thursday 19 November 2026.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated he had tidied the flat.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported that his mum gave him a poster of Leeds for his birthday.
Jamie Rowe (S2) confirmed he is attending college and doing catering on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported that staff made pizzas last week at the college catering.
Jamie Rowe (S2) confirmed he is volunteering at the garden centre on Fridays, doing watering and moving trolleys.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated he sometimes cooks his own meals at the flat, but staff help him with the oven; he can make pasta on his own.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported that Craig is the staff member mostly on night shifts.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that Craig sometimes gets cross when he gets up for a drink at night.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported that Craig told him to go back to bed when he got up for a drink.
Jamie Rowe (S2) disclosed that Craig pushed him.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that Craig pushed him into the wall in the hall outside the kitchen.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported that his shoulder hit the wall and hurt a bit.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated the incident where Craig pushed him into the wall happened last week, specifically on a Thursday night.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that Craig kicked his leg.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported that Craig kicked the back of his leg with his foot.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated Craig said the kicking was just 'messing about' and a joke.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported that Craig kicked his leg three times.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that the kicking hurt a bit and left a bruise.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported that Craig told him not to tell anyone, and that if he told, he would lose his flat.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated he does not want to lose his flat.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported that Marcus told him Craig hit Sophie, but Jamie did not see it himself.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported that Sandra helps him with money management.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated he receives his money on a Monday and makes a shopping list.
Jamie Rowe (S2) reported he sees his mum on Sundays, where she picks him up and they go to Nan's for dinner.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated that Sandra and Priya are the staff he gets on with best.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would report the disclosures of harm (pushing into wall, kicking leg) to the safeguarding team at the council.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would ring Sandra and ask that Craig does not work night shifts while the situation is looked into.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would ring Jamie's mum this afternoon.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would bring easy-read information about safeguarding to Jamie.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would return on Tuesday 1st December at 4 o'clock after college to see how Jamie is doing.
Jamie Rowe (S2) stated he wants to go to Blackpool for a holiday.
Social worker Tom Ashworth (S1) stated he would look at Jamie's holiday money.
